system.description: Once per scene, spend up to (SL) Fabula Points and Invoke a bond toward an ally to grant that ally that many Fabula Points. If the target is in Crisis, you may also Guard as a free action to grant it cover even off your turn; you cannot Guard this way again until you rest in a city or settlement.
